title: UCL EPSRC Postdoctoral Pathway Fellowships
about: UCL EPSRC Postdoctoral Pathway Fellowships, 2026/27 Round 2, for researchers whose EPSRC-funded doctoral studentship ended no earlier than 31 December 2025; candidates from any UK institution may apply. Deadline 15 January 2027 at noon UK time; interviews 26 February; start 26 April 2027.
requirements: EPSRC-funded doctoral studentship whose funding ended no earlier than 31 December 2025
Thesis submitted for examination before the start date

upskill.name: EduCut AI Academy course catalog
why: The fellowship covers engineering and physical sciences broadly and its requirements concern EPSRC doctoral funding and thesis timing; no course objective genuinely covers them, so the post links to the Academy catalog.
